label: 圆角/倒角
description: 对一个实体 shape 的边做圆角(round)或斜角(chamfer)，追加 fillet/chamfer 到 Geometry DSL。何时用：软化机箱/面板/支架等实体的锐边（type=round 圆角、type=chamfer 斜切）；只作用于 CSG/primitive 实体，不能倒 pipe/sweep/section_loft 产生的 mesh。edges=vertical 只倒平行 Z 的竖直边（盒体四立边），edges=all 倒所有边。
description-en: Round (fillet) or bevel (chamfer) the edges of a solid shape, appending `fillet`/`chamfer` to the Geometry DSL. Use when: softening the sharp edges of a solid (enclosure, panel, bracket) — `type=round` for a rounded fillet, `type=chamfer` for a flat bevel. Operates on CSG/primitive solids only, NOT on meshes from pipe/sweep/section_loft. `edges=vertical` only affects edges parallel to Z (a box's four upright edges); `edges=all` affects every edge.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.label: 几何
inputs.description: 上游 Geometry（必须含 shape_id 所指实体）
inputs.description-en: Upstream Geometry; must contain the solid referenced by shape_id.

inputs.name: shape_id
inputs.label: 形状 id
inputs.description: 被倒角的实体 shape id；从上游 shape（g_box / g_difference / g_extrude / …）的 id 输出端口连入，或填其 id 参数
inputs.description-en: Id of the solid to bevel. Feed from an upstream shape's `id` output port (g_box / g_difference / g_extrude / …), or set the shape's `id` param and pass the literal.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.label: 半径/距离
inputs.description: 圆角半径 / 斜角距离（米）。取值需小于相邻面的一半，过大 OCCT 会拒绝并回退 AABB
inputs.description-en: Fillet radius / chamfer distance (meters). Keep it below half the adjacent face; too large and OCCT rejects it (falls back to an AABB box).

inputs.name: type
inputs.label: 类型
inputs.description: round = 圆角（fillet，弧面过渡）；chamfer = 斜角（平切）
inputs.description-en: round = rounded fillet (arc); chamfer = flat bevel cut.

inputs.name: edges
inputs.label: 选边
inputs.description: all = 所有边；vertical = 仅平行 Z 轴的竖直边（如盒体四条立边）
inputs.description-en: all = every edge; vertical = only edges parallel to the Z axis (e.g. a box's four upright edges).

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.description: 本结果的自定义 id；空 = 自动 fillet{n} / chamfer{n}
inputs.description-en: Custom id for this result; empty = auto fillet{n} / chamfer{n}.

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 追加圆角/倒角后的 Geometry

outputs.name: id
outputs.label: id
outputs.description: 本行结果的 id（供下游 g_part / 其它 CSG 引用）；引用失败时为空串
outputs.description-en: Id of the result line (for downstream g_part / CSG). Empty string when the ref failed.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: 错误
outputs.description: shape_id 缺失/找不到、radius 非正、type/edges 非法时的原因；非空表示未追加任何几何——批次仍可能报 ok，务必读取此端口
outputs.description-en: Reason when shape_id is missing/not found, radius is non-positive, or type/edges are invalid. Non-empty means this op appended NOTHING even though the batch may report ok — always read this port.
